maps.name: building_01
maps.title: Collapsed building (15×20)
maps.description: Rooms and hallways behind walls with narrow doorways; the robot starts in the street.

maps.name: deck_demo
maps.title: Quick demo (4×4)
maps.description: A tiny map with two pieces of debris between the robot and the survivor; the proposal's sample run (slide 9).
maps.source: deck_demo: reproduces the slide 9 sample run (4x4, 1-indexed coordinates in comments). Start (1,1), survivor (4,4). Debris at (3,2) (seen only from (2,2)) and (4,3). (2,1) is open, so an E-skid from (1,1) lands there.

maps.name: deck_figure
maps.title: Small figure map (4×4)
maps.description: The 4×4 map of the proposal's first figure: one piece of debris next to the start.
maps.source: deck_figure: the slide 1-2 figure (start (1,1), debris at (2,1), survivor (3,4)). Only these cells are known from the slide; every other cell is open.

scenarios.name: collapsed_building
scenarios.title: Collapsed building
scenarios.description: Rooms and hallways behind 1-cell walls with narrow doorways, some collapsed; start in the street.

scenarios.name: flooded_zone
scenarios.title: Flooded zone
scenarios.description: Open ground with pools of high-slip water / mud ('~') on every shortest route and sparse debris.

scenarios.name: maze_corridors
scenarios.title: Maze corridors
scenarios.description: Winding 1-cell corridors with long dead ends and a few loops.

agents.name: andor
agents.label: AND-OR contingency
agents.description: Plans for every slip and skid in advance (a strong-cyclic plan) and replans only when the map surprises it.

agents.name: astar_fixed
agents.label: Fixed A*
agents.description: Plans one shortest path and follows it blindly; gives up at the first slip, skid or blocked cell.

agents.name: astar_replan
agents.label: A* + replan
agents.description: Follows a shortest path and re-runs A* whenever it is pushed off the path or sees new debris.

agents.name: dstar_lite
agents.label: D* Lite
agents.description: Like A* + replan, but repairs its previous search incrementally instead of starting over.

agents.name: vi_expected
agents.label: Value iteration (expected cost)
agents.description: Computes the policy with the fewest expected steps on the robot's map by value iteration over every cell.

agents.name: lao_expected
agents.label: LAO* (expected cost)
agents.description: The same optimal policy as value iteration, found by heuristic search from the robot's position.

agents.name: search_andor
agents.label: Search + AND-OR
agents.description: Explores frontier cells until survivors are seen, rescues the nearest first and plans every leg with AND-OR.

agents.name: search_astar
agents.label: Search + A*
agents.description: Explores frontier cells until survivors are seen, rescues the nearest first and plans every leg with A* + replan.

modes.name: core
modes.title: Rescue mission
modes.description: One survivor at a known location; the robot discovers debris as it drives and copes with slips and skids.

modes.name: noisy
modes.title: Noisy sensors
modes.description: noisy sensing (debris missed with probability eps)

presets.title: Quick demo (4×4)
presets.description: A tiny map: watch the AND-OR planner prepare for every slip and skid and reach the survivor in a few steps.
presets.note: The sample run of the proposal deck (slide 9): the same mission as python -m rescue.demo.

presets.title: Planners head-to-head
presets.description: AND-OR against fixed A* and A* + replan on one collapsed building, with the same map and the same random outcomes for each.

presets.title: Hidden survivor
presets.description: The survivor's location is unknown: the robot explores frontier cells until it sees the survivor.

presets.title: Noisy sensors
presets.description: The debris sensor misses debris with probability 0.1; the robot keeps a debris probability per cell.

presets.title: Blank canvas
presets.description: An empty 10x10 map to draw your own disaster zone in the editor.
